notify_me.description: Optional request for a separately approved notification addressed only to the current caller.

sandbox_check.description: Optionally request short read-only JavaScript analysis of the supplied ticket facts in the isolated Code Runtime; each execution requires separate human approval and does not change the ticket.

collaborate.description: Optionally request one fixed documents.answer AgentGroup for document support. The target, operation, endpoint, child input, and recursion policy are fixed by the Agent.
